title: Chat App (WhatsApp)
prompt: Design a 1:1 and small-group chat service like WhatsApp. Users send text messages in real time, see delivery/read receipts and online presence, and receive messages sent while they were offline.
functionalReqs: Offline delivery when the recipient reconnects (+ push notification)
nonFunctionalReqs: Low latency delivery (< 200 ms p99 within a region)
Messages are never lost and arrive in order per conversation
Highly available; tolerate WebSocket node failures
deepDives: Routing messages across WebSocket nodes (pub/sub, session registry)
Read receipts and presence at scale
